messages:
maria: Quick check — I'm prepping a doc for the oncall runbook. Where is the best dashboard to see p50/p95/p99 + TTFT and tokens/sec for model-serving in prod? Need to point engineers to a single place.

kai: Use the latency overview dashboard first: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/latency-overview
Panels to check: `TTFT (first token latency)`, `Token throughput (tokens/sec)`, and `Latency by model + seq_len`.

kai: Quick PromQL to look at p95 TTFT for the api service (change `service` label):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference",handler="first_token"}[5m])) by (le,model,service))
```

josh: For alerts, are we still using p99 > 500ms over 5m as the default? That seems noisy for cold starts.

sasha: We tuned those a month ago — p99 alert is `p99_ttft > 800ms` on 10m window for prod-general. Cold-start noise handled by `route:synthetic-warmup` being excluded in the alert rule.

sasha: If you want to lower sensitivity for model X, add `model=~"(x-small|x-medium)"` to the alert or increase the window. Also consider alerting on sustained increase in tokens/sec per instance as a secondary signal.

maria: Nice. Can you paste the exact panel link for TTFT p95 + the panel id so I can link from the runbook?

kai: Sure — p95 TTFT panel: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/latency-overview?viewPanel=7 (panel id 7). Token throughput panel id 12. Use these query params to deep-link with `var-model` and `var-region` set.

eng-obs-bot: Docs link: Observability guide — latency & tokens: https://docs.redwood.ai/obs/latency (last updated 2025-11-03) :information_source:

josh: One extra tip — in the latency-by-model panel use the `seq_len` dropdown to spot long-prefix tails. For high token-rate slices, look at `tokens/sec` + `cache_hit_ratio` to determine if batching or cache warming will help.

maria: Good call. For the runbook I want: link to TTFT panel, a short PromQL snippet, example alert config, and the note about excluding warmup route. I'll draft and post for review.

sasha: lgtm, @maria. If you want, I can open a small PR to adjust the alert threshold for the 'beta' stack after you post the draft.

maria: Please do if needed. Tagging @josh for review on alert wording.

josh: happy to review, ping me the PR. :thumbsup:

kai: Also add this quick grep to fetch relevant logs for a TTFT spike:
```
journalctl -u inference-worker --since "1 hour ago" | grep -E "first_token|kv_cache|batch_size"
```

maria: Perfect. Thanks all — I'll assemble the runbook link and drop it here when ready.
